name: inbox.meta_read
description: One inbox message with what a reply through our own Meta app needs: its platform's ids, when it came, and whether it is still open. Internal: packages/connect.
sql: select jsonb_build_object('kind', m.kind, 'platform', m.platform, 'external', m.external, 'receivedAt', brandbase.iso(m.received_at), 'open', m.done_at is null) as result from brandbase.inbox_messages m where m.id = :id and m.brand_id = :brand
